title: Environment injection and strict configuration validation
attackSurface: Deployment environment variables consumed as application configuration

hostile.title: Newline environment injection
hostile.why: Line breaks can create parser and downstream process-environment confusion

hostile.title: NUL byte environment truncation
hostile.why: NUL bytes can split JavaScript and native process views of a value

hostile.title: Dangerous URL scheme
hostile.why: Configuration URLs must not become script execution or non-network schemes

hostile.title: Credential-bearing public URL
hostile.why: Userinfo in a public URL leaks credentials and enables host confusion

hostile.title: Disallowed downstream host
hostile.why: Host allowlists prevent silent repointing of a service at attacker infrastructure

hostile.title: Port range escape
hostile.why: Out-of-range numeric configuration must fail closed

hostile.title: Command-shaped port value
hostile.why: Shell-shaped configuration text must never pass numeric validation

hostile.title: Weak production secret
hostile.why: Short or placeholder-like secrets must not be accepted into production configuration

benign.title: Canonical application URL with path
benign.why: HTTPS URL on the configured application host

benign.title: Application name with spaces
benign.why: Visible spaces are ordinary configuration text
